description: Labelled routing risk corpus. Each case records the task, any appended segments, the risk features expected from policy/risk-features.yaml version 1, the risk floor, bounds on the route risk, required experts and forbidden outcomes. Expectations derive from the task's meaning and the declared conservative policy: terms match as whole tokens after NFKC and case folding, features count wherever they appear, negated or quoted, and a feature formed anywhere in the append history (each segment, each cumulative prefix) stays. Risk narrowing is unavailable: nothing resolves a feature, so every case expects resolved to be empty. A case with narrowing_input records a structured scope for the unavailable narrowing route; routing the case with it must be refused with the risk-narrowing refusal message before any routing output, and the labels describe the same task routed without it. The scope objects are refused without being read, so the evidence paths they name need not exist. Required experts must appear in the route wherever they rank. Suffixes are appended as separate segments. Cases marked false-positive-probe are targeted probes for over-matching, not a sample from which to estimate a rate.

benign: Also fix a typo in README.
